observations.result: The python command resolves to the Windows application-execution alias, which reports that Python is not installed. The Python audit body never executes.
observations.resolution: Use already available Node and PowerShell XML parsing. No interpreter or package is installed on the shared machine.

observations.result: The initial Node audit incorrectly assumes integer truncation for console allocated-bytes/operations. Warm/64 has quotient 221016.53012048194 and the BDN report correctly records 221017.
observations.resolution: Capture exact BenchmarkDotNet v0.13.0 GcStats source and MIT license. Its BytesAllocatedPerOperation uses Math.Round with MidpointRounding.ToEven. Correct only the data-audit arithmetic, not any measurement or harness source.

observations.result: The corrected existing-evidence audit passes all 48 stdout/JSON results, statistics and allocation arithmetic, 21 independently XML-parsed TRX executions, ten characterization cases, six lifecycles and original physical bindings.

The additive combined audit also checks the separately built byte-exact relocated project and its untimed characterization: 354 unique physical files, two 131-file consumer images and 248 loaded-assembly bindings. No new timing is performed.
